_doc: T.M4 owner-sanctioned on-stage inventory for the square scene, post the T.M gesture-legend strip (batch ⑧) + the T.B facility rebuild (OD-5 riders R1/R2). The `sanctioned` set is the on-stage element inventory the restaged scene renders; any rendered on-stage element NOT in this set REDs proof:stage-inventory. The on-stage drafting-stamp gesture legend (#8) is EXPLICITLY forbidden — the owner ruled the on-stage annotation layer OUT ('remove all elements like this') and it is deleted THIS batch. The square caption/telemetry block (#11) is a ruled removal whose on-stage DOM prune rides T.B (OD-5); it is listed forbidden so the browser rendered-set reconciliation reds until T.B prunes it. SKELETON: the tether-vs-telemetry furniture disposition inside SquareInstrument is a T.B/OD-5 owner sign-off (T.M2).

status: SKELETON — the gesture-legend removal (#8) is executed THIS batch; the sanctioned subject set (stage-card + box + a11y sliders + tether) is derived from the landed DOM.
